title: Google Play 64-bit requirement and Android App Bundle (AAB) mandate
symptoms: Play Console rejects APK containing only 32-bit armeabi-v7a
Rejection when uploading raw APK instead of AAB
causes: ARM64 architecture unchecked in build settings or standalone APK uploaded

solution.action: Enable ARM64 and ARMv7 architectures with IL2CPP backend.
Generate Android App Bundle (.aab) for release submission.

prevention: Configure CI build pipeline to output .aab exclusively for release tracks.
